entries.speaker: Shadow's Voice
entries.en: Such a fool, rejecting our lord's mercy...

entries.speaker: Shadow's Voice
entries.en: In that case—witness it for yourself.

entries.speaker: Interviewer
entries.en: Oh wow, the crowd is going wild!

entries.speaker: Interviewer
entries.en: Their cheers are shaking the stadium[n]to welcome a new heroine to the world[n]of competitive gymnastics!

entries.speaker: Girl with Hair in Bun
entries.en: Thank you so much! I'm simply thrilled[n]with the results I had today!

entries.speaker: Interviewer
entries.en: Your performance exceeded anything[n]seen before in the junior class—it was[n]absolutely stunning!

entries.speaker: Interviewer
entries.en: But, you'll be entering high school[n]soon—will that impact your career[n]in gymnastics?

entries.speaker: Girl with Hair in Bun
entries.en: Oh, I have no intentions of stopping![n]It's my dream to compete and win[n]at the international level!

entries.speaker: Interviewer
entries.en: One last question—is there anyone[n]you'd like to give a shout-out while[n]you have the chance?

entries.speaker: Girl with Hair in Bun
entries.en: She should be here in the stadium...

entries.speaker: Girl with Hair in Bun
entries.en: Both of us have the same dream—to be[n]international champions!

entries.speaker: Girl with Hair in Bun
entries.en: Let's make it come true, Sumire![n]Together!

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: I really hope this helped you understand.

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: If you keep pushing on like this, you're[n]going to find nothing but heartache.

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: Please, won't you stop fighting this and[n]just return to the "current" reality?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I don't understand what you're saying,[n]but I have no intention of leaving now!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We're in agreement there. We also[n]refuse to do as you say.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Now, why don't you drop the "big voice[n]behind the curtain" act and face us[n]directly?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...He agreed to that much more readily[n]than I expected. Perhaps the Palace's[n]Ruler really will make his appearance?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But I'm fine, really! Let's go.
